notes.title: Quality of life patch
notes.notes:
Added an option to change the standard in-game camera's Field of View.
Added a framerate limiter in the options to allow for higher framerates.
Fixed an issue where the reticule was always showing even when set to off.
Fixed missing collision on cliffs in "Cool BBQ Nights."

notes.title: Visual and Performance Overhaul!
notes.notes:
We've been updating and fixing and tweaking and sweating and crunching since we released, and with the help of our wonderful community identifying issues and giving great feedback, along with some incredible work by our talented designer, we've updated every single level in the game!

Not one, not two, not twenty, but all seventy levels have been updated to be more efficient, and delightful!

Overall we've adjusted performance, unified visuals, and fixed some crazy bugs.


A perfect time to jump back in, or start a new adventure. We're always happy to have join our discord and give us your feedback more directly!

https://discord.com/invite/KBnZNwxf9q

All the best, and happy rolling!

notes.title: Patti Hattu! Cosmic Revolt is released!
notes.notes:
Well, we finally did it, a few years of hard work and very many hurdles, we reached the peak of the development and features mountain and managed to release Patti Hattu.

It's been a long journey but we're so excited to see what you can do with the game, we'd love to keep supporting and adding new content, so make sure you join us in Discord to keep prodding us or just offer feedback or have a happy lil' chat.

We'll see you in the leaderboards!

notes.title: Demo Global Leaderboards!
notes.notes:
Previously you were only able to view how your best times stacked up against your friends, and that was fine for some friendly competition.

But what if...

We've now updated the 'Patti Hattu! Cosmic Revolt' demo to have all your best times and rankings on the leaderboards to be shared globally!

Are you better than the other abductees? Now you can get 100% reliable, alien-technology-certified, unquestionable proof that you are.

Or not.

notes.title: Demo Tracks Updated
notes.notes:
Hi! We've been paying attention to the paytime of the demo and where people are spending the most time and have taken the opportunity to shuffle some tracks around in "The Trials" mode.
Some of the more demanding tracks have been removed (for now!) to allow some of the earlier tracks from the main game to take their place.

This is good news for everybody!

Primarily if you are a brand new player you will get a closer experience to the main game, with more time to get accustomed to controls, gameplay, and the general expectations the game has of you.

If you have already played the demo, then now is a great time to jump back in and enjoy some brand new levels!

We're constantly monitoring the demo to make sure you get the best experience you can, but we're only 2 people, so if you notice anything wrong or you want to offer suggestions or ideas then feel free to jump into Discord and give us a mention, we're engaged and engaging with the community and happy to answer any questions!

Good luck in The Trials!

notes.title: Abducted and forced to play our demo
notes.notes:
We're going to play through the demo and explore all the nooks and hooks, try and beat our scores and find all the tricks!
Answering any and all questions about the game, development, and the meaning of life!

notes.title: Demo is now out!
notes.notes:
Finally it's here! We've hand-picked 15 stages to represent the flow of the game and give you an idea of the first few moments in the game, with a couple of stages from later in the game.
We tried hard to have a demo that didn't drop you in with no idea how to play or didn't explain the features well enough, while trying to balance showing some of the levels where the game really opens up and starts to challenge you.
There's obviously LOADS more levels in the final game but when you start getting into the grindset and trying to compete on the Leaderboards you'll think 15 is maybe too many!
